note: Gameplay approximations of the situation on 1 January 2000 in the territory of the Islamic State of Afghanistan, a wartime government without functioning national institutions. Economy and trade: no central economic management; commerce ran through local commanders and cross-border routes (laissez_faire, free_trade). Conscription: forces were raised by the member parties' commanders (volunteer_force). Political freedom: no elections were held (no_elections). Religion: an Islamic state with sharia as a source of law (religious_law_partial). Internet: no national network existed (open_internet as the neutral default).
